description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application showcasing multi-window features. It includes methods to start various activities with specific configurations, such as custom bounds and flags, and handles UI updates related to multi-window mode detection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An activity that serves as a launcher and controller for starting other activities demonstrating multi-window features.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the main view, and updates UI elements based on multi-window mode availability.

methods.name: onStartUnresizableClick
methods.description: Handles click event to start UnresizableActivity with appropriate intent flags.

methods.name: onStartMinimumSizeActivity
methods.description: Handles click event to start MinimumSizeActivity.

methods.name: onStartAdjacentActivity
methods.description: Starts AdjacentActivity attempting to launch it adjacent to the current activity, with appropriate intent flags.

methods.name: onStartLaunchBoundsActivity
methods.description: Starts LaunchBoundsActivity with specified launch bounds set via ActivityOptions.

methods.name: onStartBasicActivity
methods.description: Starts BasicActivity using default launch mode.

methods.name: onStartCustomConfigurationActivity
methods.description: Starts CustomConfigurationChangeActivity which handles configuration changes itself.
